svg.aria-label: PXN: GPU 7 on dgx01 reaches GPU 0 on dgx02 via NIC 0, not NIC 7
svg.title: PXN: GPU 7 on dgx01 reaches GPU 0 on dgx02 via NIC 0, not NIC 7
svg.text: PXN: GPU 7 on dgx01 reaches GPU 0 on dgx02 via NIC 0, not NIC 7
Without PXN the ring's inter-node hop crosses rails (3 switch hops); with PXN NVLink moves the data to the right rail first (1 hop)
no PXN: NIC 7 → Leaf 7 → spine → Leaf 0 → NIC 0 = 3 hops
PXN: NVLink to GPU 0's NIC, then Leaf 0 only = 1 switch hop

g.title: Log signature: dgx01 [7] Channel 00/0 : 7[7] -> 8[0] [send] via NET/IB/0(7)/GDRDMA — NIC index 0, data from GPU 7.

svg.text: Log signature: dgx01 [7] Channel 00/0 : 7[7] -> 8[0] [send] via NET/IB/0(7)/GDRDMA — NIC index 0, data from GPU 7.
Needs NVLink between the GPUs (DGX/HGX), NIC-per-GPU layout and NCCL ≥ 2.12. NCCL_CROSS_NIC=0 prefers same-index rings.
If rails are mis-cabled (NIC 2 on Leaf 5) PXN still sends on NIC 2 — and the traffic crosses a spine anyway.
②–④ rail-0 path, one switch hop
①–④ without PXN: cross-rail via spine
